summary.zh: 侧边栏里的 Agent 冒了个蓝点等你回话。悬停弹出深色卡片，直接在卡片里一步步回答（单选、多选、文字），卡片高度跟着每一步的内容弹簧伸缩；提交后按钮变成对勾，卡片收回导航项，蓝点变绿消失。
summary.en: An agent in the sidebar pings you with a blue dot. Hover to open a dark card and answer its questions right there (single choice, multi-select, free text); the card’s height springs to fit each step. On submit the button morphs into a check, the card tucks back into the nav item and the dot turns green and fades.

technique.zh: 高度单独用 JS 弹簧动（ResizeObserver 量出每一步的真实高度），内容用 WAAPI 交叉淡化 + 方向滑动（前进从右进、后退从左进）。头部和底部固定，Back 按钮和 Next/Submit 文案预留宽度，所以切换不跳。
technique.en: Height is animated on its own JS spring (ResizeObserver measures each step’s natural height); content crossfades with a directional WAAPI slide (forward enters from the right, back from the left). Header and footer stay pinned and the Back / Next / Submit labels reserve their space, so nothing jumps.

desc.zh: 换题时内容横向滑动距离
提醒点 / “等你确认”的颜色

adapt.zh: 任何“需要用户补一句话”的异步任务都能用：审批、表单补全、Agent 追问。
adapt.en: Any async task that needs a quick answer: approvals, missing form fields, agent follow-ups.
